dict.string: Flash uses the Accessibility API to find clickable elements in the focused application so it can show jump-hints.
Flash controls apps for keyboard actions, reads what your media apps are playing and your notes in Notes for the flashlight, and reads browser tabs through enabled plugins.
Flash lists your contacts' names in the flashlight when you search @contacts.cards, and shows the one you pick in Contacts.
Flash shows your next event in its status bar when your configuration asks for it, and opens its meeting link with calendar join.
